title: eligibility.formal_confirmation_requested event payload (v1)
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 19d.12 (canon-0.6.0, PACK-07, ADR-030). Produced by epd2_eligibility_service.events.build_formal_confirmation_requested_event, emitted when a DigitalDecision.status=formal_confirmation_required produces its one AssemblyDecision row. Never carries digital_result itself - only the reference and deadline a confirming authority needs to act.
